## Define the functions 
```{r function}
#' function to make a barplot with swarm points given a fitted linear model
#' 
#' @params dt data.table with data
#' @params emm data.table with estimated marginal means from emmeans 
#' @params x string, x column data tables specifying group
#' @params y string, y column for dt only, emm depends on fixed emmeans values  
#' @params col string, grouping column
#' @params titl string, plot title
#' @params pal vector, list of color palette values for scale_color_manual
#' 
#' @return ggplot object
bar_swarm <- function(dt, emm, x, y, col, titl, 
                      pal = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal("Dark2", n = 7)) {
  # Convert emmeans to data.frame if needed
  if("emmGrid" %in% class(emm)) {
    emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)
  } else {
    emm_df <- emm
  }

  p <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]], color = .data[[col]], fill = .data[[col]])) +
   geom_col(
      data = emm_df,
      aes(x = .data[[x]], y = emmean, fill = .data[[x]]),
      width = 0.6
    ) +
    # Error bars using emmean ± SE
    geom_errorbar(
      data = emm_df,
      aes(x = .data[[x]], ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE, color = .data[[x]]),
      width = 0.3,
      size = 0.8,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      data = dt,
      aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]]),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, seed = 123), 
      size = 2,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    ggtitle(titl) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pal) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45, 
        hjust = 1, 
        vjust = 1, 
        family = 'Arial',
        face = 'bold',
        size = 12
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        family = 'Arial',
        face = 'bold',
        size = 8
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        face = 'bold', 
        family = 'Arial', 
        size = 12
      ), 
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5, 
        face = 'bold', 
        family = 'Arial', 
        size = 12
      ), 
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5, 
        face = 'bold', 
        family = 'Arial', 
        size = 8
      ),
      legend.position = 'none',
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    )
  # # Add conditional ordering
  # if(x == "group") {
  #   p <- p + scale_x_discrete(
  #     limits = c('CM', 'Wt', 'Wt_C31', 'PS19', 'PS19_C31'),
  #     labels = function(x) gsub("_", " + ", x)
  #   )
  # }
  return(p)
}


#' Create a Compact Summary String of a Linear Model
#'
#' This function extracts key statistics from a linear model summary and formats 
#' them into a compact string suitable for plot subtitles or inline reporting.
#' The string includes R-squared, F-statistic with degrees of freedom, and p-value.
#'
#' @param model An object of class 'lm' (linear model)
#' @param digits Integer indicating the number of decimal places for R-squared and F-statistic (default: 3)
#' @param p_digits Integer indicating the number of decimal places for p-value (default: 3)
#' @param include_adj_r logical; whether to include adjusted R-squared (default: FALSE)
#'
#' @return A character string containing formatted model statistics
#'
#' @examples
#' # Create a simple linear model
#' model <- lm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)
#' 
#' # Get compact summary string
#' model_subtitle(model)
#' 
#' # Use in a ggplot
#' library(ggplot2)
#' ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
#'   geom_point() +
#'   geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
#'   labs(subtitle = model_subtitle(model, include_adj_r = TRUE))
#'
#' @export
model_subtitle <- function(model, digits = 3, p_digits = 3, include_adj_r = FALSE) {
  # Check input
  if (!inherits(model, "lm")) {
    stop("Input must be a linear model object of class 'lm'")
  }

  # Extract model summary
  s <- summary(model)

  # Extract components
  r_squared <- round(s$r.squared, digits)
  f_stat <- round(s$fstatistic["value"], digits)
  df1 <- s$fstatistic["numdf"]
  df2 <- s$fstatistic["dendf"]
  p_value <- pf(s$fstatistic["value"], df1, df2, lower.tail = FALSE)

  # Format p-value
  if (p_value < 2e-16) {
    p_str <- "p < 2e-16"
  } else if (p_value < 10^(-p_digits)) {
    p_str <- paste("p =", formatC(p_value, format = "e", digits = 2))
  } else {
    p_str <- paste("p =", round(p_value, p_digits))
  }

  # Build the result string
  if (include_adj_r) {
    adj_r_squared <- round(s$adj.r.squared, digits)
    result <- sprintf("R² = %s (adj. R² = %s), F(%d, %d) = %s, %s", 
                     r_squared, adj_r_squared, df1, df2, f_stat, p_str)
  } else {
    result <- sprintf("R² = %s, F(%d, %d) = %s, %s", 
                     r_squared, df1, df2, f_stat, p_str)
  }

  return(result)
}


#' Generalized linear model based on a flexible formula
#'
#' @param dat Data.table with the original data
#' @param m0 lmerMod baseline model with without the exposure element
#' @param outcome String specifying the column in dat containing the outcome variable
#' @param exposure String specifying the column in dat containing the exposure variable
#' @param covs Vector of column names containing covariates to be included in the formula
#' @param mat dsCMatrix a Generalized relatedness matrix
#'
#' @returns A list: 'Estimate' (beta), 'Std. Error' (se), 't value' (test statistic), 'Pr(>Chisq)' (p-value), 'nobs' (number of observations)
get_linreg <- function(dat, outcome, exposure, covs = c(), mat) {
  m <- relmatLmer( # remember in the formula, exposure must come first after ~
    as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(exposure, covs, "(1|PIDN)"), collapse = " + "))),
    data = dat,
    relmat = list(PIDN = mat)
  )
  t <- suppressWarnings(anova(m0, m))
  a <- summary(m)
  return(as.list(c(a$coefficients[2, ], t$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2], nobs = nobs(m))))
}

#' Recodes dummy categorical variables and can subset by vector of categories
#'
#' @param dat Data.table with the original data
#' @param dcol String representing the column to be split
#' @param keep Vector of strings that are the categories within dcol to extract. default is all c()
#'
#' @returns modified data.table with new dummy variable columns named "dcol.category" after original column
recode_dummies <- function(dat, dcol, keep = c()) {
  dt <- dat
  # check input
  if (length(keep) == 0) {
    inds <- unique(dt[[dcol]])
  } else if (length(keep) > 0 & all(keep %in% unique(dt[[dcol]]))) {
    inds <- unique(dt[[dcol]])[unique(dt[[dcol]]) %in% keep]
  } else {
    stop("Keep must be a vector of names in the original column")
  }
  # split out dummies
  dt[, c(paste(dcol, inds, sep = ".")) := lapply(inds, function(x) ifelse(get(dcol) == x, 1, 0))]
  # reorder behind original variable
  v <- grep(paste0("^", dcol, "$"), names(dt))[1]
  inds <- paste(dcol, inds, sep = ".")
  setcolorder(dt, c(names(dt)[1:v], inds, names(dt)[(v + 1):(ncol(dt) - length(inds))]))
  return(dt)
}
```

```{r make_seurat, include=FALSE}
# load overall base file
result <- fread("dataProt_SS-205063.merged.QC.csv")
a <- result[, 1:27]
a[, Date.of.draw := NULL]
a[Diagnosis_group == "MCI-AD", Diagnosis_group := "MCI"]
a[, last_diagnosis := Diagnosis_group[which.max(DS1V)], by = PIDN]

x <- fread("genomic/mypcair.PCs.csv", colClasses = c(PIDN = "character"))
a <- merge(a, x, by = "PIDN")

# setup for eigengenes vs NES scores
if (score %like% "eigengenes") {
  tail <- "csv" 
  score_val <- "Eigengene"
  scores <- fread("module_scores/STRING_merged_scaled_scores.csv")
  scores <- unique(scores[, .(Biomarker, cluster, term)])
  scores[, name := paste0("ME", Biomarker, "-", cluster)]
  scor <- scores[, term]
  names(scor) <- scores[, name]
} else if (score %like% "WSS") {
  tail <- "csv" 
  score_val <- "Weighted Sum of Scores"
  scores <- fread("module_scores/STRING_merged_scaled_scores.csv")
  scores <- unique(scores[, .(Biomarker, cluster, term)])
  scores[, name := paste0(Biomarker, ".", cluster)]
  scor <- scores[, term]
  names(scor) <- scores[, name]
} else {
  tail <- "normalized_scores.csv"
  score_val <- "NES"
  scor <- NULL
}

# Map in PCs assumes your primary data table exists 
x <- fread(
  file.path(data_path, 
    paste("dataProt_SS-205063", score, tail, sep = ".")
  ), 
  colClasses = c(SampleID = "character")
)
a <- merge(a, x, by = "SampleID")
# checking that eigengenes succeeded
input <- names(scor)[names(scor) %in% names(a)]

# drop outlier samples
drop = a[abs(ConnectivityZscore) > 10, SampleID]
a = a[!SampleID %in% drop]

# only APOE
a <- a[APOE != ""]

# Add in phenotypes for individuals -----------------
x <- data.table(
  readxl::read_xlsx(
    "../ADRC traits/Z1XADRCNACC_DATA_LABELS_2021_10_18_matchMetadata_allSamples.xlsx",
    sheet = "Z1XADRCNACC_DATA_LABELS_2021_10"
  )
)

a <- merge(a, 
  x[, .(Sample_Id, CDRSUM, MOCATOTS)], 
  by.x = "SampleID", 
  by.y = "Sample_Id", 
  all.x = TRUE, 
  sort = FALSE
)

# get final Diagnosis
a[, last_diagnosis := Diagnosis_group[which.max(Visit)], by = PIDN]

# clean cog scores
a[MOCATOTS > 30, MOCATOTS := NA]

# convert MoCA
conv <- fread("Haji_2025.CDRSUM-2-MoCA.csv")
setkey(conv, `CDR-SB`)
a[, MoCA := fifelse(
  Diagnosis_group == "AD" & !is.na(Diagnosis_group),
  conv$AD.MoCA[match(CDRSUM, conv$`CDR-SB`)],
  conv$Full.MoCA[match(CDRSUM, conv$`CDR-SB`)]
)]
a[!is.na(MOCATOTS), MoCA := MOCATOTS]

# get final cog score
a[, last_MoCA := MoCA[which.max(Visit)], by = PIDN]
a[, last_CDRSUM := CDRSUM[which.max(Visit)], by = PIDN]

# Calculate MoCA velocity (slope per 365 days) for participants with 2+ visits
a[!is.na(MoCA), MoCA_velocity := {
    if (.N >= 2) {
      # Fit linear model: MoCA ~ DS1V
      fit <- lm(MoCA ~ DS1V)
      # Extract slope and convert to per-year rate
      coef(fit)[2] * 365
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  }, 
  by = PIDN
]

# Floor cognitively normal improvers and remove low baseline improvers
a[, MoCA_v_floored := {
  baseline_score = MoCA[which.min(DS1V)]
  fcase(
    MoCA_velocity > 1e-10 & baseline_score < 17, NA_real_,  # Exclude low baseline improvers
    MoCA_velocity > 1e-10, 0,                                # Floor other improvers
    default = MoCA_velocity                                  # Keep decliners/stable
  )
}, by = PIDN]


# Setup for baseline visit only analysis ---------------------------
# get the first visit for each score, with Diagnosis_group, Age, Gender, APOE, HybControlNormScale
b <- lapply(input, function(i) {
  x <- a[!is.na(get(i))][, value := get(i)]
  x <- x[, .(PIDN, SampleID, DS1V, value, Diagnosis_group, Age, Gender, APOE, HybControlNormScale, CDRSUM, MOCATOTS)]
  # keep only first visit where plasma available
  x <- x[order(DS1V)][, head(.SD, 1), by = "PIDN"]
})
setattr(b, 'names', input)
b <- rbindlist(b, idcol = 'Score')
# b[, .N, by = Score]
b[, Score := factor(Score, levels = sort(unique(Score)))]
setnames(b, "value", score_val)

# for this plot, reclassify MCI-AD as MCI
b[, Diagnosis_group := gsub("MCI-AD", "MCI", Diagnosis_group)]
b$Diagnosis_group <- factor(b$Diagnosis_group, levels = c("HC", "MCI", "AD"))
a[, Diagnosis_group := gsub("MCI-AD", "MCI", Diagnosis_group)]
a$Diagnosis_group <- factor(a$Diagnosis_group, levels = c("HC", "MCI", "AD"))

# define the baselines

a_base <- a[SampleID %in% samp]
```

## Save clinical data
```{r}
lapply(c("a_base", "a_after"), function(j) {
  dt <- copy(get(j))
  print(names(dt))
  dt <- merge(dt, 
    x[, .(Sample_Id, CBTIA, TBI, DIABETES, CVCHF, CVHATT, CVAFIB, CVANGINA, HYPERCHO, HYPERTEN, DEP2YRS, ANXIETY)], 
    by.x = "SampleID", 
    by.y = "Sample_Id", 
    all.x = TRUE, 
    sort = FALSE
  )
    
  dt[!is.na(DIABETES), DIABETES := ifelse(DIABETES == 1 | DIABETES == 2, 1, 0)]
  cols <- c("CBTIA", "TBI", "CVCHF", "CVHATT", "CVAFIB", "CVANGINA", "HYPERCHO", "HYPERTEN", "DEP2YRS", "ANXIETY")
  dt[, (cols) := lapply(.SD, function(i) ifelse(i == 2, 0, i)), .SDcols = cols]
  
  # check values
  summary_long <- melt(dt[, .SD, .SDcols = c(cols, "DIABETES")], measure.vars = c(cols, "DIABETES"))[
    , .(count = .N), by = .(variable, value)
  ]
  dcast(summary_long, variable ~ value, value.var = "count", fill = 0)
  
  # simplified AD
  dt[, Diagnosis_bin := fcase(
    Diagnosis_group == "HC", 0L,
    Diagnosis_group == "AD", 1L,
    Diagnosis_group == "MCI", NA_integer_
  )]
  dt[, last_diag_bin := fcase(
    last_diagnosis == "HC", 0L,
    last_diagnosis == "AD", 1L,
    last_diagnosis == "MCI", NA_integer_
  )]
  
  set.seed(123)
  dt[, RAND := sample(c(0L, 1L), size = .N, replace = TRUE)]
  
  assign(j, dt, envir = .GlobalEnv)
})

fwrite(a_base, file = file.path("dataProt_SS-205063.baseline_clin.csv"))
fwrite(a_after, file = file.path("dataProt_SS-205063.follow-up_clin.csv"))
```

# Check MoCA velocity outcomes
Some are positive potentially representing practice effect
```{r moca_veloc}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Prepare data for visualization
fig_data <- a[!is.na(MoCA_velocity), .(
  first_MoCA = MoCA[which.min(DS1V)],
  last_MoCA = MoCA[which.max(DS1V)],
  change = MoCA[which.max(DS1V)] - MoCA[which.min(DS1V)],
  n_visits = .N,
  time_span_years = (max(DS1V) - min(DS1V)) / 365,
  velocity = MoCA_velocity,
  velocity_cleaned = MoCA_v_floored
), by = PIDN]

# Add trajectory classification
velocity_tolerance <- 1e-10
fig_data[, trajectory := fcase(
  velocity > velocity_tolerance & first_MoCA < 17, "Improver (low baseline, excluded)",
  velocity > velocity_tolerance & first_MoCA >= 17, "Improver (practice effect, floored)",
  abs(velocity) <= velocity_tolerance, "Stable",
  velocity < -velocity_tolerance, "Decliner"
)]

# Set factor levels for ordering
fig_data[, trajectory := factor(trajectory, levels = c(
  "Improver (low baseline, excluded)",
  "Improver (practice effect, floored)",
  "Stable",
  "Decliner"
))]

# Color scheme
traj_colors <- c(
  "Improver (low baseline, excluded)" = "#D55E00",
  "Improver (practice effect, floored)" = "#F0E442",
  "Stable" = "#999999",
  "Decliner" = "#0072B2"
)

# Simpler 3-panel version
p1_simple <- ggplot(fig_data, aes(x = first_MoCA, y = last_MoCA, color = trajectory)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = traj_colors, name = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, 5), limits = c(5, 30)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, 5), limits = c(5, 30)) +
  labs(
    x = "Baseline MoCA Score",
    y = "Final MoCA Score",
    title = "A"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

p2_simple <- ggplot(fig_data, aes(x = velocity , fill = trajectory)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = traj_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 10, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "MoCA Velocity (points/year, raw)",
    y = "Count",
    title = "B"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

fig_data_cleaned <- fig_data[!is.na(velocity_cleaned)]
p3_simple <- ggplot(fig_data_cleaned, aes(x = velocity_cleaned , fill = trajectory)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = traj_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 10, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "MoCA Velocity (points/year, cleaned)",
    y = "Count",
    title = "C"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

simple_plot <- p1_simple / (p2_simple | p3_simple) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.8), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path("manuscript", "Figure_4", 
    "Supplementary_Figure_MoCA_Trajectories_Simple.pdf"
  ), 
  plot = simple_plot, 
  width = 8, 
  height = 7
)
```

# Seurat Object
Use seurat for convenient access to PCs, UMAPs, plotting on eigengenes in the `scale.data` layer.
```{r}
# Use your scaled data as the count matrix (Seurat requires some data in counts slot)
cols1 <- c("SampleID", input) 
cols2 <- names(a_base)[!names(a_base) %in% input] 
exp <- as.matrix(transpose(a_base[, ..cols1], keep.names = "GENE", make.names = "SampleID"), rownames = "GENE")
sc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = exp, 
  project = "dataProt_SS-205063",
  meta.data = data.frame(a_base[, ..cols2], row.names = "SampleID")
)

# Replace the scale.data slot with your actual scaled data
LayerData(sc, assay = "RNA", layer = "scale.data") <- exp

VariableFeatures(sc) <- rownames(sc)
```

## Clustering
Checking the clusters. This could also make use of Biodomain and Celltype eigengenes, although that may violate some assumptions of independence between the eigengenes.
```{r}
pcs <- 7
sc |>
  RunPCA(npcs = pcs) |>
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:pcs) |>
  FindClusters(resolution = 1) |>
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:pcs) -> sc

# check clusters
DimPlot(sc)

# look at eigengene composition
markers <- data.table(FindAllMarkers(sc, test.use = "t", slot = "scale.data"))
setorder(markers, cluster, p_val_adj, p_val)
DoHeatmap(sc) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(100))
```

So a seurat based approach using PCs produces ok clusters, but doesn't capture the obvious groupings...
```{r test_diff}
# get adjusted values
int = FALSE
dat_col <- 'MoCA_v_floored'
plot_col <- 'MoCA_v_floored (batch adj)'
dt <- data.table(sc@meta.data, keep.rownames = "SampleID")

# for diagnosis group
dt$Diagnosis_group <- factor(dt$Diagnosis_group, 
  levels = c("HC", "MCI", "AD"), 
  ordered = TRUE
)

# INT transform for cog tests
if (int){
  dt[!is.na(get(dat_col)), c(dat_col) := RankNorm(get(dat_col))]
}

# # first checked glms for cog tests
# # diagnosis glm drop MCI
# dt <- dt[Diagnosis_group != "MCI"]
# dt$Diagnosis_group <- droplevels(dt$Diagnosis_group)
# glm model
glm <- glm(
  data = dt,
  formula = MoCA_v_floored ~ Age + Gender + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + PC6 + PC7 + PC8 + seurat_clusters
)
summary(glm)

# # then check ordinal diagnoses
# plo <- clm(
#   data = dt,
#   formula = Diagnosis_group ~ Age + Gender + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + PC6 + PC7 + PC8 + seurat_clusters
# )
# summary(plo)
# nominal_test(plo)


# Check diagnostics of the model
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(glm)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))


# Shapiro test for normality of residuals
shapiro.test(residuals(glm))

# Levene test for homogeneity of variances
leveneTest(as.formula(MoCA_v_floored ~ seurat_clusters), data = dt)

# Get estimated marginal means
emm <- emmeans(glm, "seurat_clusters")
print(emm)

# Pairwise comparisons against PS19 reference
comparisons <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "seurat_clusters2", adjust = "bonferroni")
print(comparisons)

# adjusted values
if (int) {
# Combine EMMs with individual sample residuals INT
  dt[!is.na(get(dat_col)), c(plot_col) := 
       summary(emm)$emmean[match(seurat_clusters, summary(emm)$seurat_clusters)] + residuals(glm)
  ]
  # dt[get(plot_col) < 0, c(plot_col)] <- 0
} else {
  dt[!is.na(get(dat_col)), c(plot_col) := 
       summary(emm)$emmean[match(seurat_clusters, summary(emm)$seurat_clusters)] + residuals(glm)
  ]
  # dt[get(plot_col) < 0, c(plot_col)] <- 0
}

p1 <- bar_swarm(dt,
```

```{r trends}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

plot_data <- a_base %>%
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    change = case_when(
      is.na(last_MoCA) | is.na(MoCA) ~ "Missing",
      MoCA > last_MoCA ~ "Increasing",
      MoCA < last_MoCA ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE ~ "No Change"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(last_MoCA, MoCA),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("last_MoCA", "MoCA")))

# Create the plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = timepoint, y = score, group = id)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = change), linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increasing" = "#2E7D32",
                                "Decreasing" = "#C62828",
                                "No Change" = "#757575",
                                "Missing" = "#FFA726")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("last_MoCA" = "Last MoCA", "MoCA" = "Current MoCA")) +
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "MoCA Score",
       color = "Change",
       title = "MoCA Score Changes") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())



```



```{r correlation_to_biomarkers}
library(data.table)
library(corrplot)
library(Hmisc)

# Calculate correlation with p-values
cor_result <- rcorr(as.matrix(a_base[, ..names]), 
                    as.matrix(a_base[, ..bios]))

# Extract correlation between eigengenes (rows) and biomarkers (columns)
cor_matrix <- cor_result$r[bios, names]
p_matrix <- cor_result$P[bios, names]

# Plot - show all squares but only label significant ones
corrplot(cor_matrix,  # Use the masked matrix for coefficients
         method = "square",
         type = "full",
         tl.col = "black",
         tl.srt = 45,
         addCoef.col = "black",
         number.cex = 0.6,
         p.mat = p_matrix,
         insig = 'blank',
         mar = c(0, 0, 1, 1)
)

# Add title with precise control
title("Eigengenes vs Biomarkers (coefficients shown for p < 0.05)", 
      line = 0.1,  # Distance from plot (adjust this)
      cex.main = 1)  # Title size
```

## Functions
```{r func}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

plot_heatmap_with_sig <- function(dt, 
                                   row_var = "ix", 
                                   col_var = "dx", 
                                   value_var = "beta",
                                   pval_var = "pval",
                                   padj_var = "padj",
                                   nobs_var = "nobs",
                                   pval_thresh = 0.05,
                                   padj_thresh = 0.05,
                                   midpoint = 0,
                                   low_color = "blue",
                                   mid_color = "white",
                                   high_color = "red",
                                   row_order = NULL,
                                   col_order = NULL) {
  
  # Create significance indicators
  dt_plot <- copy(dt)
  dt_plot[, sig_type := fcase(
    get(padj_var) < padj_thresh, "padj",
    get(pval_var) < pval_thresh, "pval",
    default = "ns"
  )]
  
  # Apply row ordering
  if (!is.null(row_order)) {
    dt_plot[[row_var]] <- factor(dt_plot[[row_var]], levels = row_order)
  }
  
  # Apply column ordering
  if (!is.null(col_order)) {
    dt_plot[[col_var]] <- factor(dt_plot[[col_var]], levels = col_order)
  }
  
  # Get nobs per column (assuming constant within each column)
  nobs_labels <- dt_plot[, .(nobs = unique(get(nobs_var))), by = c(col_var)]
  
  # Create nobs labels for secondary axis
  col_breaks <- if (!is.null(col_order)) col_order else unique(dt_plot[[col_var]])
  nobs_bottom <- sapply(col_breaks, function(x) {
    n <- nobs_labels[get(col_var) == x, nobs]
    paste0("n=", n)
  })
  
  # Create the base heatmap
  p <- ggplot(dt_plot, aes(x = .data[[col_var]], y = .data[[row_var]])) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = .data[[value_var]]), color = "gray90") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = low_color,
      mid = mid_color,
      high = high_color,
      midpoint = midpoint,
      name = value_var
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, position = "top", 
                     sec.axis = dup_axis(labels = nobs_bottom, name = NULL)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0),
      axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x.top = element_text(margin = margin(b = 10))
    ) +
    labs(x = col_var, y = row_var)
  
  # Add borders for pval significance (gray)
  if (any(dt_plot$sig_type == "pval")) {
    p <- p + geom_tile(
      data = dt_plot[sig_type == "pval"],
      aes(x = .data[[col_var]], y = .data[[row_var]]),
      fill = NA,
      color = "gray50",
      linewidth = 0.8
    )
  }
  
  # Add borders for padj significance (black)
  if (any(dt_plot$sig_type == "padj")) {
    p <- p + geom_tile(
      data = dt_plot[sig_type == "padj"],
      aes(x = .data[[col_var]], y = .data[[row_var]]),
      fill = NA,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.8
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```
